findings.historical_behavior: History-notes and image-generation extension requests used default HTTP clients that did not carry the configured application network policy.
findings.current_behavior: The upstream change passes Config::http_client_factory() into both extension backends and creates API-class transports so configured network restrictions and proxy behavior are honored.
findings.codex_scope_impact: Tracked as an evidence-backed unsupported runtime/network semantic. The deterministic core does not execute network requests, extensions, plugins, hooks, or MCP servers.
findings.verification: Verified from the upstream commit diff and its added regression coverage. Codex Scope does not claim a local runtime reproduction because runtime network execution is outside the safety contract.
